interface_contract.ci-gates family: pattern becomes /^\.github\/workflows\/|^scripts\//, so EVERY script under scripts/ is gate tooling, named individually or granted as a directory. HIGH_RISK_PREFIXES ci-gates stays ['.github/workflows/', 'scripts/'].
interface_contract.justified(value): collapse internal whitespace to single spaces, trim, then require BOTH >= 40 characters AND >= 8 whitespace-separated words. Used by solo_justification, serialization_justification, depends_on_reason and overlap_decision.
interface_contract.root builder: a builder is a root only when its depends_on contains NO known assignment id of ANY role. A dependency on a reviewer id therefore blocks root status.
interface_contract.parallelBuilders: CORRECTED BY THE LEAD after C2 caught the contradiction: the first draft of this contract said parallelBuilders was 'unchanged' while also redefining what a root is, and parallelBuilders IS the root count, so the two sentences could not both hold. The truthful number is the one that answers 'how many builders can actually start now', so parallelBuilders counts roots under the new any-role definition: a builder waiting on a reviewer is not counted. workstreams deliberately keeps the builder-only dependency graph, because a reviewer does not join two builders into one workstream.
interface_contract.parallelIdentities: count of concurrent real identities among root builders: each root with agent 'claude-subagent' counts as one identity; all roots sharing any other agent value collapse to one identity for that agent value. Returned on the result as parallelIdentities, alongside parallelBuilders.
interface_contract.rule parallel_dispatch_missing: now fires when there are >= 2 builders and parallelIdentities < 2, unless plan.serialization_justification passes justified().
interface_contract.rule serial_dependency_unjustified: NEW failing code. A builder whose depends_on includes another builder's id must carry its own depends_on_reason passing justified(); message names the builder and the dependency.
interface_contract.planAreas: root-level files that are NOT *.md now all map to the single area 'root' instead of one area each. Root-level *.md still maps to 'docs'. Everything else unchanged.
interface_contract.rule solo_justification_missing: span = planAreas(allowed).length + (riskFamilies(allowed).length >= 2 ? 1 : 0). Fires when span >= 2 and plan.solo_justification does not pass justified(). This makes a whole-tree grant such as ['src/'] fire while a single gate script or a package.json pair does not.
interface_contract.model n/a: MODELS gains 'n/a', valid ONLY for agents that are not 'claude-lead' or 'claude-subagent'. A Claude agent declaring 'n/a' fails with NEW code model_not_applicable_misused. model_underpowered and reviewer_model_underpowered are skipped entirely for non-Claude agents, because Siton does not choose their model. model_overpowered likewise never fires for them.
interface_contract.accepted overlaps: plan.accepted_overlaps is an array of paths. An open_work_overlap whose builder path matches a listed path is downgraded from a finding to the warning open_work_overlap_accepted. The downgrade applies ONLY when plan.overlap_decision passes justified(); otherwise the finding stands and NEW code overlap_decision_missing is added.
interface_contract.result shape: result gains parallelIdentities. Existing keys ok, findings, warnings, builders, workstreams, parallelBuilders are unchanged. TEAM_PLAN_SUMMARY gains parallel_identities.
interface_contract.npm + CI: package.json gains "team:plan-check": "node scripts/team_plan_check.cjs". backend-quality-gates.yml gains ONE step running `node --test tests/release_tools/team_plan_check.test.cjs`, NOT the whole release-tools suite, which carries 9 failures that already exist on master.
